questions.question: What was total net revenue in March 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many orders were cancelled in Q1 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM fct_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

questions.question: Who are the top 5 customers by lifetime revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT customer_name, lifetime_revenue FROM dim_customers ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What was revenue by product category in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fct_order_lines WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 200

questions.question: What was the average order value by month in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT order_month, avg_order_value FROM mart_monthly_revenue WHERE order_month >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_month < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

questions.question: Which month had the highest net revenue in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT order_month, net_revenue FROM mart_monthly_revenue WHERE order_month >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_month < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many customers do we have per country?
questions.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM dim_customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 200

questions.question: What was the cancellation rate in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

questions.question: Which 3 products sold the most units in 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM fct_order_lines WHERE status IN ('completed', 'shipped') AND order_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many customers have placed more than 15 orders?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM dim_customers WHERE lifetime_orders > 15 LIMIT 200

questions.question: What share of orders came from each channel in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many new customers signed up each month in 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date) AS signup_month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM dim_customers WHERE signup_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND signup_date < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

questions.question: What was total revenue from customers in Germany?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fct_orders AS o JOIN dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'DE' AND TRUE LIMIT 200

questions.question: List the names of customers in the business segment who signed up in 2026
questions.sql: SELECT customer_name FROM dim_customers WHERE signup_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND signup_date < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) AND segment = 'business' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM dim_customers WHERE lifetime_orders = 0 LIMIT 200

questions.question: What was the total discount given in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

questions.question: What was revenue in each quarter of 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT QUARTER(order_date) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

questions.question: What is the average number of units per order for completed orders?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS avg_units FROM fct_orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND TRUE LIMIT 200

questions.question: Which customer segment generated the most revenue in 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fct_orders AS o JOIN dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
